body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 61b185ccbdd0ddf0f76eed161c4e8802db5673cf -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

What looks good
- With no wear and no layer step, `side_burn_worn` returns `side_burn` output at once. The test `sinker_side_worn_off_is_the_plain_side_burn` pins equal moves and notes. No golden is changed in the diff, so `sinker_side_burn.cl` is unchanged.
- The removed refusal is replaced by `sinker_wear::burn_compensated`. Bad rate (NaN, negative, 1.0), bad layer step, short electrode, deepest-tip bound, allowance and orbit refusals remain, each by name (`sinker_side_worn_keeps_every_refusal_by_name`). A half-stated or bad measured wear is still refused at command creation by `compensation_refusal`.
- Compensation deepens each layer tip by the wear. The lateral move runs at the last compensated tip. The tip is checked against the deepest-tip bound. No move goes below that bound. No check is loosened.
- The condition wear rate is not applied to a side burn, so saved side burns post the same bytes. The decision file explains this.
- The UI only adds rows to the page draft. The draft still applies through the existing command. There are no flecs calls in ui.
- Test is in the owning crates. Files are under 400 lines. Provenance is kept.

Results merged with main (local, no Actions run)
- `camcraft-motion --lib sinker_side`: 5 passed.
- `camcraft-app --test sinker_side`: 6 passed. `--test sinker_wear`: 6 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Mutation check: I moved the lateral move 0.5 mm above the compensated tip. `sinker_side_worn_plunges_in_compensated_layers_and_moves_at_the_deepest_tip` failed. I reverted it.

Requested before merge
- None.

Notes (not blocking)
- The new UI rows have no structural test. The PR body says so.
- Side wear is not compensated. The wall is left short, never past the allowance. This is stated in the code and the decision.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
